id.description: The unique numerical identifier for the product.

title.description: The name of the created product.

body_html.description: The HTML description content of the product.

vendor.description: The vendor or brand associated with the product.

product_type.description: The category classification assigned to the product.

created_at.description: The timestamp indicating when the product was created.

handle.description: A URL-friendly human-readable slug for the product.

updated_at.description: The timestamp indicating when the product was last modified.

published_at.description: The timestamp when the product was published to sales channels, or null if unpublished.

template_suffix.description: The custom Liquid template applied to the product page, if any.

published_scope.description: The visibility range where the product is available, such as global or web.

tags.description: A comma-separated string of search and categorization tags.

status.description: The current lifecycle state of the product.

admin_graphql_api_id.description: The globally unique GraphQL API identifier for the product.

items.description: A variant instance of the product.

variants.description: The list of variants available for this product.

options.description: The configurable options defined for this product.

items.description: An image attached to the product.

images.description: The list of image assets attached to the product.

image.description: The primary featured image for the product, or null if none is set.

description: Response returned when a product is successfully created.
